#夏萱不雅照吸毒#

微博热门上，几乎被夏萱给承包了，她一个红透半边天的影后，在受伤后却被爆出读书时候的不雅照，看戏的人会少吗？

夏萱所在的医院被记者围得水泄不通，不时有记者溜进去，弄得那边人仰马翻的，一时间时笙这边的热度就被压了下去。

“这次你运气好，也不知道谁出手了，如果没有这件事，你知道你现在面对的是什么吗？你明知道她对你有敌意，你还往她面前凑！！就算你们是节目组要求在一起的，你就不能离她远点吗？节目组又没让你们当连体婴儿！！”

唐隐在电话中继续咆哮，他的冷静早就被吃掉了。

都是青春，一去不复返。

时笙嘴角一阵抽搐，满头黑线的道：“当一个人想要害你的时候，会有一百种方法，你觉得防得住吗？”

“那倒也是。”唐隐估计是吼完了，吐出一口浊气，又恢复了冷静模式，“虽然夏萱现在这个样子，但是那些照片也不算大事，等过几天就会平复下去，可你这件事不同，他们那边口口声声说有证据，到时候……”

“唐哥，这事你不用操心了，她没那个机会了。”时笙打断唐隐。

既然她已经动手了，就不会给夏萱翻身的机会。

唐隐那边沉默了下来，电话中寂静无声，良久，他沉着嗓音道：“这件事是你干的？”

“唐哥，你什么时候见我放任敌人逍遥，却什么都不做的？”

“行，那我不管你了。”这女人做事，能当场报复的绝对会当场报复，如果当场报复不能回本，那么她就会忍下来，然后让你爬得高高的，在把你拉下来。

他不止一次庆幸，他和她站在同一战线，而不是她的对立面。

挂了电话，时笙嘴角勾起一抹浅笑，那笑容凉薄而讽刺。

夏萱，接下来，就好好体验一下，江晚当初经历过的一切吧。

夏萱的事，虽然影响到了节目组，但是节目组也不可能停拍，所以时笙依旧在节目组拍摄。

节目组的人对夏萱受伤真相明显很好奇，可那个摄影小哥也说不清，当时他回过神，夏萱就已经滚下去了，而时笙就站在边上，看那样子真的像是摄影机记录下来的，是她将夏萱推下去的。

节目组的人喜欢夏萱的比较多，所以时笙的待遇就受到了一些刁难。

就连一向对她和颜悦色的林导演都离她远了一些，不是必要问题，绝对不会凑到她面前来。

#电影影视hurended, suspected to be man-made#

#Goddess’s unknown past#

#XiaXuanIndecent Photos of Taking Drugs#

On Weibo, Xia Xuan was almost taken over. She was a popular movie queen, but after she was injured, indecent photos of her when she was studying were exposed. Will there be fewer people watching the show?

The hospital where Xia Xuan was staying was surrounded by reporters. From time to time, reporters sneaked in, causing everyone there to flip over. The heat in Shi Sheng's side was suppressed for a while.

"You're lucky this time, and I don't know who took action. If it hadn't been for this, do you know what you're facing now? You knew she was hostile to you, but you still got in front of her!! Even if you were asked by the program team to be together, couldn't you stay away from her? The program team didn't let you be conjoined twins!!"

Tang Yin continued to roar on the phone, his calmness had long been eaten away.

It’s all youth, gone forever.

The corner of Shi Sheng's mouth twitched and he said with black lines on his head: "When someone wants to harm you, there are a hundred ways to do it. Do you think you can prevent it?"

"That's true." Tang Yin probably finished his yelling, exhaled a breath, and returned to calm mode, "Although Xia Xuan is like this now, those photos are not a big deal. They will calm down in a few days. But your matter is different. They keep saying there is evidence. When the time comes..."

"Brother Tang, you don't have to worry about this. She won't have that chance." Shi Sheng interrupted Tang Yin.

Now that she has taken action, she will not give Xia Xuan a chance to stand up.

Tang Yin fell silent, and there was silence on the phone. After a long time, he said in a calm voice: "Did you do this?"

"Brother Tang, when did you see me letting my enemies run free but not doing anything?"

"Okay, then I don't care about you." When this woman does something, if she can retaliate on the spot, she will definitely retaliate on the spot. If retaliation on the spot cannot pay off, then she will endure it, then let you climb high, and then pull you down.

He was thankful more than once that he was on the same side as her rather than on the opposite side of her.

After hanging up the phone, Shi Sheng's lips curved into a slight smile, which was cold and sarcastic.

Xia Xuan, next, let’s experience everything Jiang Wan went through.

Although Xia Xuan's incident affected the program team, it was impossible for the program team to stop filming, so Shi Sheng was still filming on the program team.

The people on the program team were obviously very curious about the truth about Xia Xuan's injury, but the camera guy couldn't tell clearly. When he came to his senses, Xia Xuan had already rolled down, and Shi Sheng was standing on the side. It looked like it was recorded by the camera that she pushed Xia Xuan down.

The people in the program team liked Xia Xuan a lot, so Shi Sheng's treatment was somewhat difficult.

Even Director Lin, who had always been kind to her, stayed away from her. It was not a necessary issue and he would never get in front of her.
